title: When Lower Privileges Suffice: Investigating Over-Privileged Tool Selection in LLM Agents
title_zh: 低权限足矣时：研究 LLM Agent 中的过度权限工具选择
abstract_en: As LLM agents increasingly select tools autonomously, their choices among tools with different privileges become safety-relevant. However, prior tool-selection studies focus on safety-agnostic metadata preferences, leaving privilege-sensitive choices underexplored. To address this gap, we study over-privileged tool selection, in which an agent selects or escalates to a higher-privilege tool despite a sufficient lower-privilege alternative. We introduce ToolPrivBench to evaluate whether agents choose higher-privilege tools despite sufficient lower-privilege alternatives, measuring both initial selection and escalation after transient tool failures. Across eight domains and five recurring risk patterns, we find that over-privileged tool selection is common among mainstream LLM agents and is further amplified by transient failures. We further find that general safety alignment does not reliably transfer to least-privilege tool choice, while prompt-level controls provide only limited mitigation under transient failures. We therefore introduce a privilege-aware post-training defense that teaches agents to prefer sufficient lower-privilege tools and escalate only when necessary. Our mitigation experiments show that this defense substantially reduces unnecessary high-privilege tool use while preserving general capabilities.
abstract_zh: 随着 LLM agents 越来越多地自主选择工具，它们在不同权限工具之间的选择开始具有安全影响。以往工具选择研究多关注与安全无关的元数据偏好，较少考察权限敏感场景。本文研究“过度权限工具选择”（over-privileged tool selection）：即在低权限工具已经足够完成任务时，agent 仍选择或升级到更高权限工具。作者提出 ToolPrivBench，用于评估 agents 是否会在存在充分低权限替代方案时选择高权限工具，并同时衡量初始选择与短暂工具故障后的权限升级行为。实验覆盖 8 个领域和 5 类反复出现的风险模式，结果显示主流 LLM agents 普遍存在过度权限工具选择，且短暂故障会进一步放大这一问题。研究还发现，通用安全对齐并不能可靠迁移到最小权限工具选择；prompt 级控制在短暂故障下缓解效果有限。为此，作者提出一种权限感知的后训练防御方法，训练 agents 优先选择足够的低权限工具，并仅在必要时升级。缓解实验表明，该方法能显著减少不必要的高权限工具使用，同时保持通用能力。
key_points_zh: 提出 over-privileged tool selection 概念：当低权限工具已足够时，LLM agent 仍选择或升级到高权限工具，带来最小权限原则失效的安全风险。
构建 ToolPrivBench，覆盖 8 个应用领域与 5 类风险模式，评估初始工具选择以及短暂工具失败后的权限升级行为。
实验发现主流 LLM agents 普遍存在过度权限选择问题，且 transient failures（短暂故障）会显著增加不必要的高权限工具使用。
通用 safety alignment 不能稳定迁移到 least-privilege tool choice；仅靠 prompt-level controls 在故障场景下缓解有限。
提出 privilege-aware post-training defense，使 agent 学会优先使用足够的低权限工具、仅在必要时升级，并在保持能力的同时显著降低高权限工具滥用。

llm_assessment.comment: This is highly relevant security work on least-privilege tool selection, with benchmark evidence and a mitigation direction for safer production agent runtimes.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项高度相关的安全研究，聚焦最小权限工具选择，并提供了基准证据和面向生产智能体运行时的缓解方案。
